hero_title: Prompt to live site. On your server.
hero_subtitle: Describe your idea. Groundstation writes the page, builds the container, and ships it to a VPS you already own.
social_proof_badge: Join your fellow indie hackers on the list

features.title: Live in 90 seconds
features.description: Prompt, preview, deploy. No Dockerfiles, no DNS tickets, no build queue.

features.title: Your box, your rules
features.description: Deploys to the Hetzner or DigitalOcean droplet already sitting half empty.

features.title: Designs that convert
features.description: Hand-built templates, not scraped ones. Dark, sharp, and tested on real traffic.

features.title: You own the code
features.description: Full source pushed to your GitHub. Walk away with everything, any time.

features.title: Keys stay yours
features.description: Credentials never touch our database. Nothing for us to leak or lose.

features.title: Domains on autopilot
features.description: Point a domain once. Records, redirects and SSL renew themselves.

faq.question: Do I need to know Docker or Coolify?
faq.answer: No. If you can paste an API token, you can deploy. Everything underneath is generated, wired and verified for you.

faq.question: What does hosting cost?
faq.answer: Whatever your VPS costs. A five dollar box runs a dozen landing pages. We never charge per project or per seat.

faq.question: Can I edit the site afterwards?
faq.answer: Yes. Re-prompt any section, or clone the repo and edit it like any other Next.js project. No lock-in, no proprietary format.

faq.question: When does it open?
faq.answer: Private beta this quarter, in small batches. The waitlist goes out in order, and early users keep founder pricing for life.

footer_note: No spam. One email when we open the doors.
